title: Rain shell
text: A waterproof hooded jacket for rainy hikes. Packs into its pocket and blocks wind.

title: Trail water filter
text: A compact filter that makes stream water drinkable during a hiking trip. No electricity needed.

title: Sleeping quilt
text: An insulated quilt for sleeping outdoors on cool nights. Lightweight backpacking bedding.

title: Camp lantern
text: A rechargeable lamp that lights a campsite after sunset. Warm light and a hanging hook.

title: Quiet keyboard
text: A low-noise keyboard for shared offices and late-night typing. Soft keys and a compact layout.

title: Desk riser
text: A platform that lifts a computer display to eye level. Space underneath for notebooks.

title: Focus headphones
text: Over-ear headphones reduce background noise during work calls and focused reading.

title: Task lamp
text: An adjustable desk lamp illuminates paper and books without lighting the whole room.

title: Insulated lunch jar
text: A sealed insulated container keeps soup hot until lunch. Wide mouth for easy cleaning.

title: Coffee hand grinder
text: A manual burr grinder for fresh coffee beans. Turn the handle to choose a coarse or fine grind.

title: Kitchen scale
text: A digital scale measures flour and ingredients by weight for precise baking. Grams and ounces.

title: Tea infuser
text: A reusable metal basket holds loose tea leaves while they steep in a mug of hot water.

title: Packing cubes
text: Zipped fabric organizers separate clothing inside a suitcase. Three sizes for tidy travel.

title: Neck pillow
text: A soft travel pillow supports the head while resting in an airplane or train seat.

title: Pocket power bank
text: A rechargeable portable battery charges a phone away from wall outlets. USB-C connection.

title: Luggage tag
text: A durable identification tag helps identify a suitcase. Includes a covered name and contact card.
